name: 2023-1c-parcial2
title: Driving assistant with manual, automatic and assisted-manual modes
description: A real-time driving assistant reads a speed sensor and a front proximity sensor on each #tick and, depending on its mode (manual, automatic or assisted-manual) and on whether the object ahead is in the danger, warning or safe zone, tells the driving system to beep, brake, connect or disconnect the throttle and keep a speed; the student must design and test it from scratch with TDD.

design.notes: Two independent axes (three driving modes x three distance zones plus no object) must be modelled without a 3x4 grid of ifs, the assisted-manual mode is the composition of the other two, sensors are simulated with ReadStreams, the driving system is a collaborator whose state the tests must observe, and the boundaries of the zones (DMF inclusive, 2*DMF inclusive) demand careful test cases.
